title: Aoashi Season 2 Main Trailer Previews Theme Song, October 4 Premiere Revealed
content: The upcoming second season of AOASHI has unveiled its main trailer, featuring the new theme songs ahead of the anime’s October 4 premiere. Studio TMS Entertainment was previously confirmed to be taking over from Production I.G for the animation production.
author: Anime Corner

title: Toshiko Machida's Hanako-gari Manga Ends
content: Kodansha 's Pocket Magazine platform published the final chapter of Toshiko Machida 's Hanako-gari (Hanako Hunt) manga on August 27. The story is set in a world where spirits run rampant.
author: ANN

title: bilibili App Relaunches Globally Without ID Verification
content: The Chinese streaming service bilibili relaunched a global version of its app on Android on August 19. The new app does not require identity verification when posting overseas, which the previous app required, and is reportedly mixing Chinese and International content.
author: ANN

title: Pokemon: Wild Card Proves Ash Might Never Come Back (And That’s Ok)
content: Pokemon: Wild Card is the first time that we’ve seen a Pokemon movie in years, with the previous example being Pokemon: Secrets of the Jungle back in 2020. This recent film wasn’t just the last time that the franchise hit the big screen in Japan; it was the last film led by Ash Ketchum.
author: ComicBook

title: One Room Angel Artist Harada Launches First Seinen Manga
content: This year's 17th issue of Hakusensha 's Young Animal magazine announced on Friday that boys-love manga artist Harada will launch her first seinen series titled Akuen in the Young Animal Zero magazine on September 9, as well as on the Young Animal Web platform.
author: ANN

title: Shonen Jump Creator Breaks Silence On Cancellation With Final Goodbye: “I Have Regrets”
content: Shueisha’s Weekly Shonen Jump magazine has officially cancelled yet another major series this year, and the creator behind it all is breaking hearts with their final message responding to the cancellation.

title: All-Male Precure Stage Play Returns With Colorful Runway! Production in December
content: The official website for Dancing☆Star Precure , the first stage play in Toei Animation 's long-running Precure ( Pretty Cure ) anime franchise , announced a new all-male stage play centered on fashion titled Colorful Runway!
